description: Fetches the stored receipt for an authorized past run. Returns policy result and available hashes, signing state, conditional TEE evidence, anchor references, and stored provider-readback verification evidence without upgrading missing evidence.

run_id.description: The run ID to retrieve, returned by yax_execute_action or yax_pay_x402, e.g. run_7f29c91a.

name: yax_get_receipt

anchored_at.description: Legacy receipt-seal timestamp, not by itself proof of anchoring.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the action inputs.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the action outputs.

policy.description: Full policy result including version, ShadeGuard decision, and approval identity.

proof.description: Anchor references and provider GET readback/content-match evidence, when available.

receipt_signature.description: Stored HMAC signature or unsigned digest marker; inspect signature verification state.

tee_attestation.description: Conditional TEE evidence reference; presence alone is not verified TEE binding.
